walk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production low-resolution pixel-art sprite sheet for a 2D topdown RPG. Character KALI: short young boy, shoulder-length LONG RED HAIR, rounded-corner dark eyeglasses, a slightly dirty WHITE LONG-SLEEVE shirt underneath a faded BLACK SHORT-SLEEVE T-SHIRT (very clear layered clothes: black torso and short upper sleeves, off-white forearms), loose baggy torn BLACK PANTS, WHITE SNEAKERS. No hoodie. No cape. Small boy proportions, not tall adult. Limited palette, strong dark outline, crisp square pixel clusters. Intended native character height 40 pixels; simple readable design matching classic small RPG sprites, no high resolution detail or smooth shading.
Create EXACTLY 24 full body sprites in FOUR ROWS and SIX COLUMNS with transparent background. Each row is a six-frame walking loop. Row1 ALL six face FRONT/south; Row2 ALL six face LEFT/west (nose left, hair behind head to right); Row3 ALL six face RIGHT/east (nose right, hair behind head to left); Row4 ALL six face BACK/north (back of red hair, no face/glasses). Slight overhead RPG camera, not isometric.
Six genuinely different sequential poses per row: left-foot contact, recoil, passing, right-foot contact, opposite recoil, opposite passing. Arms counter swing. Keep head/body centered and same size within every cell, uniform feet baseline and only tiny body bob. BOTH white sleeves and black short sleeves must remain consistent. Baggy pants with knee tears, white shoes visibly alternate positions. All six frames in every row must have correct direction, especially sixth LEFT frame still faces LEFT. Equally spaced regular grid, generous transparent gaps around each full figure, same scale in all24 sprites. Integer pixel enlargement acceptable. No text, labels, grid lines, scenery, floor shadow or glow. Genuine transparent alpha.
idle:
Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is identity and style reference for KALI. Create matching IDLE animations, NOT walking. Exactly SIXTEEN sprites in FOUR ROWS x FOUR COLUMNS, isolated on genuine transparent alpha. Same short boy, same long RED hair, rounded-corner black eyeglasses, faded black SHORT-SLEEVE T-shirt worn OVER dirty off-white LONG-SLEEVE shirt, baggy torn black pants and WHITE sneakers. Preserve outfit, proportions and limited pixel palette exactly. Native logical height40px, crisp small 2D topdown RPG sprite, no smooth gradients.
ROW1 four FRONT-facing idle breathing frames; ROW2 four LEFT-facing idle breathing frames, all noses LEFT; ROW3 four RIGHT-facing idle breathing frames all noses RIGHT; ROW4 four BACK-facing idle breathing frames, no face visible. In ALL frames feet are close together and planted, arms rest at sides. Four-frame breathing sequence neutral, slight inhale, exhale, neutral with brief blink (only where face visible). Subtle tiny shoulder/hair motion only, at most1 logicalpixel bob, same foot baseline, head size and silhouette stable. Absolutely no stepping or walking stances. Equal cell sizes, regular4x4grid, generous fully transparent gaps, all figures complete. No text, labels, shadows, floor, glow, scenery, decorative background. Preserve long red hair, visible white undersleeves below black short sleeves, dirty faded clothing, torn loose trousers, rounded rectangular glasses and white shoes in every frame.
